title: Down from the High Pasture

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Welcome up, friend! Feel that wind? Autumn's coming to the mountain. Time to bring the flock down from the high pasture.

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Will you help me count them into the pens? Three in each: a ewe and her two half-grown lambs.

steps.speaker: silas
steps.prompt: Put three sheep in each pen. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a pen with an empty dip, and put a sheep there.

older.prompt: Four sheep in each of five pens. No dips this time: count in fours. How many in all?

feedback.full: That pen is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four pens of three: twelve sheep, safe and sound!

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: Look how big the spring lambs have grown! You settled them into pens when they were tiny, remember?

journal_line: I helped Mr. Silas bring the flock down from the high pasture.

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: Five pens of four: twenty sheep! And every one of them a friend of mine.
